issues.title: [0.1.2] [Benchmark] Establish a reproducible latency and quality experiment baseline
issues.description:
## Objective

Create the controlled baseline and acceptance protocol for all six algorithms before candidate tuning.

## Context

Research source: docs/references/latency-optimization-research.md and latency-research/evidence.json at product baseline b2a680578f65ac65653a8160f04a3d97a5c5e71e. Sentinel: USDC→USDT 1000, Mantle block 101082044, daily_gross. One noisy case is not a performance distribution. Preserve protocol integer/state correctness, immutable snapshots, independent final evaluation, all failures/coverage and the six reference identities including pinned uni_sor_port. This is planned 0.1.2 work; do not start it during the research request.

## Blocked By

* <issue id="6133a267-0526-4165-a296-bd05ede80b21" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1502/012-docs-research-routing-latency-and-publish-the-optimization">WHI-1502</issue>

## Blocks

* <issue id="0aadfc47-c6f4-4092-a1bb-ea16bf42590a" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1504/012-pools-experiment-with-exact-skipping-of-empty-zero-liquidity-cl">WHI-1504</issue>
* <issue id="424bf855-7d4e-49f3-9b16-1c16900b40ec" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1505/012-pools-evaluate-bounded-reuse-of-exact-tick-and-bin-math">WHI-1505</issue>
* <issue id="ff03a945-8d93-40e0-9379-a0482b34f33d" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1507/012-routing-evaluate-incremental-marginal-score-and-cycle-check-reuse">WHI-1507</issue>
* <issue id="073c4a6d-9f62-48ed-a639-20026723cca5" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1508/012-routing-experiment-with-an-opt-in-sor-candidate-shortlisting">WHI-1508</issue>

## Execution

* Complexity: high
* Reason: Runner boundaries, repeatability, workload coverage and quality comparisons cross multiple contracts.
* Expected scope: New benchmark/latency.py driver and report/latency.py summaries; `benchmark/worker.py` and `benchmark/results.py` only for explicit metrics; config/latency/, tests/benchmark/ and docs. Preserve ordinary quote semantics.

## Implementation

1. Freeze source/bundle/profile/objective/budgets and a compact matrix: the user sentinel, representative pairs and small/large amounts, matched V2/V3 versus full cohorts, CPMM/CL/LB, dense/sparse ranges, tick/bin rounding boundaries, shared pools and failures. Separate tuning from held-out cases.
2. Measure solve wall and process CPU separately from prepare/startup, IPC, independent evaluation and complete single-request response. Distinguish six-algorithm CLI total. Collect stage/work profiles separately; cProfile/tracemalloc time is never headline latency.
3. Pre-register machine/load controls, run order, repetitions/sample count, warmup, noise floor and minimum worthwhile improvement before optimization runs. Run paired baselines/candidates sequentially. Do not infer p95 from n=3. Declare cold/warm cache lifecycles, hit/miss and peak-memory accounting.
4. Use a separate driver or batch runner for replication; quote must still invoke each selected solver exactly once. Compare exact integers/plans/status/state/parity on sufficient budgets; report completion under fixed budgets separately. Retain every scheduled outcome and searched-versus-eligible scope.
5. Define paired heuristic regret relative to the same-scope best-known reference, not a mathematical optimum; preserve N/A for unknown net scores. Optional API capture must redact secrets and specify endpoint/chain/amount/preference/type/output/timing/cache conditions. Missing credentials or Mantle support does not block local work.

## Out of scope

Every experiment must end with explicit adopt/reject evidence. Adopt only under L01 measurement/correctness rules; a rejected idea is not an implemented speedup. Charge preprocessing, cache population, memory and final evaluation; distinguish cold/warm and instrumented/uninstrumented runs. The quote command must remain one solve per algorithm, without extra warmups/retries. No language rewrite, service deployment, Jupiter integration, rewritten frozen results/default profiles or universal subsecond/API-equivalence claim. No approximate variant becomes a default without explicit acceptance of its quality trade-off.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A versioned offline command reproduces the fixed six-algorithm matrix and sentinel.
- [ ] Timing labels and an artificial prepare/solve-delay test prove cost cannot disappear across boundaries; quote invocation-count regression passes.
- [ ] All statuses/cohorts and deterministic semantic comparisons are recorded; cold/warm and load conditions are explicit.
- [ ] Measurement and exact/heuristic acceptance rules precede candidate tuning; no unsupported tail/SLA claim appears.

## Testing / Verification

Focused worker/result/quote tests, bounded real-corpus replay and reverse run order; relevant pytest, Ruff and mypy. Do not rerun the entire hours-long v1 campaign solely to establish this compact matrix.

## References

docs/DESIGN.md; docs/references/latency-optimization-research.md §§1–8; docs/references/latency-research/evidence.json; docs/references/uni-sor-port-contract.md. Pinned upstream source links are in the research register.

Research plan key: L01.

issues.description:

Evaluate skipping provably empty zero-liquidity spans without changing exact quote behavior.

## Context

* <issue id="0af7283d-8090-4ba2-b960-277c8ac1a262" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1503/012-benchmark-establish-a-reproducible-latency-and-quality-experiment">WHI-1503</issue>

## Blocks

* <issue id="424bf855-7d4e-49f3-9b16-1c16900b40ec" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1505/012-pools-evaluate-bounded-reuse-of-exact-tick-and-bin-math">WHI-1505</issue>
* <issue id="c1412c86-b383-483a-a9c0-846de7bf0a43" href="https://linear.app/whisker-personal/issue/WHI-1506/012-pools-experiment-with-exact-reuse-of-cl-traversal-prefixes-across">WHI-1506</issue>

## Execution

* Complexity: high
* Reason: Traversal shortcuts must preserve Solidity rounding, range failures, returned state and protocol features.
* Expected scope: pools/concentrated.py, pools/cl_math.py, minimal lazy derived index; tests/pools/ and experiment evidence. No search-policy change.

## Implementation

1. Reconfirm the hypothesis across L01 cases: the sentinel counted 478425 zero-liquidity/uninitialized steps out of 908823 CL steps. This count is not a predicted time saving.
2. Use a minimal bounded/lazy known-state index; skip only when liquidity is zero and no initialized tick or required transition lies inside the span. Stop at initialized ticks, price limits, MIN/MAX ticks and collected-state boundaries. Unknown bitmap state is never empty.
3. Preserve output, consumed input, final sqrt price/tick/liquidity, fee/protocol/hook state, checked failures and immutable inputs. Preserve logical protocol step/features for cost accounting even when fewer Python operations execute.
4. Never casually skip positive-liquidity word boundaries: uninitialized boundaries can still affect integer rounding/fees. Handle exact exhaustion and zero-cost transitions in both directions.
5. Compare independent fixtures/reference transition results and complete SOR quote/selection behavior. Charge index setup and memory; measure incremental work and cold/end-to-end latency, then adopt or explicitly reject.

## Out of scope

Every experiment must end with explicit adopt/reject evidence. Adopt only under L01 measurement/correctness rules; a rejected idea is not an implemented speedup. Charge preprocessing, cache population, memory and final evaluation; distinguish cold/warm and instrumented/uninstrumented runs. The quote command must remain one solve per algorithm, without extra warmups/retries. No language rewrite, service deployment, Jupiter integration, rewritten frozen results/default profiles or universal subsecond/API-equivalence claim. No approximate variant becomes a default without explicit acceptance of its quality trade-off.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exact integer/state/failure equivalence passes across admitted CL sources and both directions.
- [ ] Tests cover long empty spans, initialized liquidity changes, exact exhaustion, price limits, incomplete ranges and dense positive-liquidity counterexamples.
- [ ] Snapshot immutability and logical protocol features remain valid.
- [ ] Reduced executed work and paired measured effects support the disposition; all six references and SOR goldens pass on sufficient budgets.

## Testing / Verification

Concentrated-pool differential/stateful and generated sparse/dense fixtures, SOR goldens, paired L01 runs including setup. No float approximation, range widening or missing-state suppression.

## References

docs/DESIGN.md; docs/references/latency-optimization-research.md §§1–8; docs/references/latency-research/evidence.json; docs/references/uni-sor-port-contract.md. Pinned upstream source links are in the research register.
